trailhead.label: Place de la Fontaine in Chichilianne, by the church, the board’s start

cautions: Two river crossings, one by a ford: the stones can be slippery and the water higher after rain.
A short steep forest climb to Le Châtel.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Place de la Fontaine in Chichilianne, by: Place de la Fontaine a Chichilianne, vicino alla chiesa, la partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.Two river crossings, one by a ford: the: Due attraversamenti del fiume, uno a guado: i sassi possono essere scivolosi e l'acqua più alta dopo la pioggia.
Una breve salita ripida nel bosco fino a Le Châtel.
Si attraversa una volta la D 7B.
